gaps.sentence: Factory workers are paid ___ at the end of each week.
gaps.hint: pay for manual work, usually weekly
gaps.explanation: 'Wages' are paid weekly, often in cash, for manual or unskilled work; salaries are monthly.

gaps.sentence: She has lived in this street ___ 2015.
gaps.hint: starting point of a period up to now
gaps.explanation: 'Since' is used with a point in time when the situation started and continues; 'for' is used with a length of time.

gaps.sentence: Thousands of people were forced to ___ their homes.
gaps.hint: a verb is needed after 'to'; meaning: abandon
gaps.explanation: 'Desert' is also a verb meaning to abandon; 'dessert' is only the sweet course of a meal.

gaps.sentence: Please state your ___ on the application form.
gaps.hint: the formal word for your type of work, used on forms
gaps.explanation: 'Occupation' is the formal word for a person's job or profession, typically used on official forms.

gaps.sentence: Pens, envelopes and paper are sold in the ___ department.
gaps.explanation: 'Stationery' means writing materials; 'stationary' is an adjective meaning not moving.
'Complement' means to combine well with or complete something; 'compliment' means to praise.

gaps.sentence: He is very ___ to criticism and takes it personally.
gaps.hint: easily affected or hurt; pattern: ___ to
gaps.explanation: 'Sensitive to something' means easily affected or upset by it; 'sensible' means showing good judgement.

gaps.sentence: There was ___ anything left in the fridge.
gaps.hint: adverb meaning almost not at all
gaps.explanation: 'Hardly' means almost not ('hardly anything'); 'hard' means with effort or solid.
